## 更新内容

- 自动发现本机兼容工具的 Codex 实例，包括运行中的来源；显示来源与运行状态，选择后预览会话和项目。复制前关闭来源客户端并确认，复制时重新检查，保留原目录和原工具实例。
- 修复 CLI 已结束但尚未被父进程回收时，被错误识别为存活进程的问题；正确保存最终登录刷新结果并恢复配置，仍拒绝身份不匹配的运行进程。
- 修正登录关联回归测试中的跨秒快照差异，保持过期凭据拒绝规则不变。
- 创建实例自动生成可修改、不重复的名称；缺少必填项时立即提示，并定位问题字段。完善账号、供应商、密钥、设置等表单的错误反馈。
- 新增会话起点选择：空白会话、从已停止实例复制、从本机目录复制。启动前可查看会话、归档和项目概况，搜索项目详情。
- 修复复制历史后会话不可见、只出现在“最近”或项目分组为空的问题；复制时保留项目归属、排序和固定项，原目录保持不变。
- 每条 API 连接可按模型独立配置上下文窗口，未设置时显示继承的默认值；配置在解除关联、导入导出、备份和回收恢复后保留。
- 创建实例时复用同地址、同密钥的兼容 API 连接，保留其模型、上下文、服务等级及代理配置。
- 适配 Codex 26.930.41038 和 26.930.51102 的内置语言、普通 / Fast 菜单、默认 Codex 页面，以及模型目录声明支持的 Ultra 推理档位。
- 修复无效 API 地址导致表单验证异常，以及 SSH / 计划任务的配置对象复制异常。
- 界面版本号与软件包自动保持一致。发布流程在测试、安装包验证和上传文件校验通过后，正式发布 Release。

## Changes

- Automatically discover local Codex instances from compatible tools, including running sources. Show source and runtime status, then preview sessions and projects. Close and confirm the source client before copying; the copy rechecks its state and preserves the original directory and instance.
- Fixed terminated CLI processes awaiting parent reaping being mistaken for live processes. Final login rotations are retained and configuration recovery completes while mismatched running processes remain protected.
- Removed a clock-boundary mismatch from login-association test fixtures while retaining stale-credential rejection.
- Automatically suggest editable, available instance names. Missing fields produce immediate feedback and focus the affected field. Improved error feedback for accounts, providers, keys and settings.
- Choose a fresh session, copy a stopped instance, or copy a local directory. Review session, archive and project summaries before launch, with searchable project details.
- Fixed copied conversations becoming invisible, appearing only under Recents, or losing project grouping. Copies retain project assignments, ordering and pinned items while preserving the source directory.
- Configure per-model context windows for individual API connections, with visible inherited defaults. Settings survive unlinking, import/export, backups and recycle-bin restoration.
- Reuse compatible API connections with the same endpoint and key while retaining their models, context settings, service tier and proxy configuration.
- Added compatibility for Codex 26.930.41038 and 26.930.51102: built-in language display, Standard / Fast selection, the default Codex surface, and Ultra reasoning when advertised by the model catalogue.
- Fixed invalid API URLs causing validation exceptions and configuration-copy failures in SSH and scheduled-task forms.
- The visible version now follows the package version. Releases are published after tests, packaged-app checks and uploaded-asset verification pass.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）DMG / ZIP 和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。升级前退出管理器，再安装新版；已有账号、实例与本地配置保留。安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证，应用内自动更新尚未接入。

DMG and ZIP installers are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Quit the manager before installing the update; existing accounts, instances and local settings are retained. Developer ID signing, notarization and in-app automatic updates are not included.

当前只实现 Codex 接入。语言、速度及推理档位取决于客户端版本、模型和服务商；本次未宣称完成真实账号的付费 Fast / Ultra 请求验收。

Codex is the only implemented client. Language, speed and reasoning options depend on the client version, model and provider. Paid Fast / Ultra requests with real accounts were not part of this validation.
